name: Couchbase
summary: A Couchbase cluster: down and missing nodes, restarts, connection jumps, index memory, auto-failover, rebalances and N1QL errors, timeouts, time and queue.
needs: A Prometheus instance that scrapes the Couchbase exporter (Couchbase Server 7 metrics such as up, kv_uptime_seconds and n1ql_requests).

placeholders.label: Prometheus
placeholders.help: The Prometheus instance that scrapes the Couchbase exporter.

placeholders.label: Cluster
placeholders.help: A short name for this cluster in the check names, ids and card texts, such as orders-prod.

placeholders.label: Selector
placeholders.help: The label matchers that pick this cluster in every query, such as job=~".*couchbase.*",env="prod". Each one is label, operator, quoted value.

checks.name: Couchbase ${cluster} node down
checks.title: {instance} down
checks.text: Couchbase node {instance} in ${cluster} is down: up is 0, Prometheus cannot reach its metrics endpoint.

checks.name: Couchbase ${cluster} node not scraped
checks.query: (max by (instance) (up{${selector}} offset 1d) unless on (instance) max by (instance) (up{${selector}})) and on () (count(up{${selector}}) > 0)
checks.title: {instance} not scraped
checks.text: Prometheus had an up sample for Couchbase node {instance} in ${cluster} a day ago and has none now: its scrape target is gone or the node left the cluster.

checks.name: Couchbase ${cluster} node restarted
checks.title: {instance} restarted
checks.text: Couchbase node {instance} in ${cluster} has been up for only {value} s: its data service restarted in the last hour.

checks.name: Couchbase ${cluster} connection jump
checks.query: (max by (instance) (max_over_time(kv_curr_connections{${selector}}[60m])) > 1.5 * max by (instance) (label_replace(max by (instance) (max_over_time(kv_curr_connections{${selector}}[60m] offset 1d)), "base", "1d", "", "") or label_replace(max by (instance) (max_over_time(kv_curr_connections{${selector}}[60m] offset 7d)), "base", "7d", "", ""))) and (max by (instance) (max_over_time(kv_curr_connections{${selector}}[60m])) > max by (instance) (label_replace(max by (instance) (max_over_time(kv_curr_connections{${selector}}[60m] offset 1d)), "base", "1d", "", "") or label_replace(max by (instance) (max_over_time(kv_curr_connections{${selector}}[60m] offset 7d)), "base", "7d", "", "")) + 200) and on (instance) (max by (instance) (up{${selector}}) >= 0.5)
checks.title: {instance} connections jumped to {value}
checks.text: Couchbase node {instance} in ${cluster} peaked at {value} client connections in the last 60 min: more than 1.5 times, and 200 more than, the peak of the same window 1 day or 1 week earlier.

checks.name: Couchbase ${cluster} index memory
checks.query: 100 * max by (instance) (index_memory_used_total{${selector}}) / max by (instance) (index_memory_quota{${selector}}) and on (instance) (max by (instance) (up{${selector}}) >= 0.5)
checks.title: {instance} index memory {value} % of quota
checks.text: The index service on {instance} in ${cluster} uses {value} % of its memory quota; this stays info, because a full index quota slows index builds and scans before it fails them.

checks.name: Couchbase ${cluster} auto-failover
checks.title: auto-failover in ${cluster}
checks.text: Couchbase cluster ${cluster} failed over a node automatically in the last 60 min: a node stopped answering and its data moved to the replicas.

checks.name: Couchbase ${cluster} rebalance stuck
checks.title: rebalance stuck in ${cluster}
checks.text: Couchbase reports a stuck rebalance in ${cluster}: moving data between the nodes stopped making progress.

checks.name: Couchbase ${cluster} rebalance running
checks.title: rebalance running in ${cluster}
checks.text: A rebalance is running in Couchbase cluster ${cluster}; expect slower queries until it finishes.

checks.name: Couchbase ${cluster} N1QL errors
checks.query: (100 * sum(increase(n1ql_errors{${selector}}[60m])) / (sum(increase(n1ql_requests{${selector}}[60m])) > 0) > ((max(label_replace(100 * sum(increase(n1ql_errors{${selector}}[60m] offset 1d)) / (sum(increase(n1ql_requests{${selector}}[60m] offset 1d)) > 0), "base", "1d", "", "") or label_replace(100 * sum(increase(n1ql_errors{${selector}}[60m] offset 7d)) / (sum(increase(n1ql_requests{${selector}}[60m] offset 7d)) > 0), "base", "7d", "", "")) + clamp_min(max(label_replace(100 * sum(increase(n1ql_errors{${selector}}[60m] offset 1d)) / (sum(increase(n1ql_requests{${selector}}[60m] offset 1d)) > 0), "base", "1d", "", "") or label_replace(100 * sum(increase(n1ql_errors{${selector}}[60m] offset 7d)) / (sum(increase(n1ql_requests{${selector}}[60m] offset 7d)) > 0), "base", "7d", "", "")), 0.5)) or on () vector(1))) and on () (sum(increase(n1ql_errors{${selector}}[60m])) >= 20)
checks.title: N1QL error share {value} % in ${cluster}
checks.text: N1QL queries on ${cluster} failed at {value} % in the last 60 min: at least 20 errors, and more than 1 % while no baseline exists, else more than twice and 0.5 points above the share of the same window 1 day or 1 week earlier.

checks.name: Couchbase ${cluster} N1QL errors critical
checks.query: (100 * sum(increase(n1ql_errors{${selector}}[60m])) / (sum(increase(n1ql_requests{${selector}}[60m])) > 0) > ((max(label_replace(100 * sum(increase(n1ql_errors{${selector}}[60m] offset 1d)) / (sum(increase(n1ql_requests{${selector}}[60m] offset 1d)) > 0), "base", "1d", "", "") or label_replace(100 * sum(increase(n1ql_errors{${selector}}[60m] offset 7d)) / (sum(increase(n1ql_requests{${selector}}[60m] offset 7d)) > 0), "base", "7d", "", "")) + clamp_min(max(label_replace(100 * sum(increase(n1ql_errors{${selector}}[60m] offset 1d)) / (sum(increase(n1ql_requests{${selector}}[60m] offset 1d)) > 0), "base", "1d", "", "") or label_replace(100 * sum(increase(n1ql_errors{${selector}}[60m] offset 7d)) / (sum(increase(n1ql_requests{${selector}}[60m] offset 7d)) > 0), "base", "7d", "", "")), 0.5)) or on () vector(1))) and on () (sum(increase(n1ql_errors{${selector}}[60m])) >= 20)
checks.title: N1QL error share {value} % in ${cluster}
checks.text: N1QL queries on ${cluster} failed at {value} % in the last 60 min: at least 20 errors, and more than 1 % while no baseline exists, else more than twice and 0.5 points above the share of the same window 1 day or 1 week earlier.

checks.name: Couchbase ${cluster} N1QL timeouts
checks.title: {value} N1QL timeouts in ${cluster}
checks.text: {value} N1QL queries on ${cluster} timed out in the last 60 min, more than twice the same window 1 day or 1 week earlier; each one is an error for its caller.

checks.name: Couchbase ${cluster} N1QL time
checks.query: (sum(increase(n1ql_request_time{${selector}}[60m])) / (sum(increase(n1ql_requests{${selector}}[60m])) > 0) / 1e6 > ((max(label_replace(sum(increase(n1ql_request_time{${selector}}[60m] offset 1d)) / (sum(increase(n1ql_requests{${selector}}[60m] offset 1d)) > 0) / 1e6, "base", "1d", "", "") or label_replace(sum(increase(n1ql_request_time{${selector}}[60m] offset 7d)) / (sum(increase(n1ql_requests{${selector}}[60m] offset 7d)) > 0) / 1e6, "base", "7d", "", "")) + clamp_min(max(label_replace(sum(increase(n1ql_request_time{${selector}}[60m] offset 1d)) / (sum(increase(n1ql_requests{${selector}}[60m] offset 1d)) > 0) / 1e6, "base", "1d", "", "") or label_replace(sum(increase(n1ql_request_time{${selector}}[60m] offset 7d)) / (sum(increase(n1ql_requests{${selector}}[60m] offset 7d)) > 0) / 1e6, "base", "7d", "", "")), 50)) or on () vector(200))) and on () (sum(increase(n1ql_requests{${selector}}[60m])) >= 300)
checks.title: N1QL average {value} ms in ${cluster}
checks.text: N1QL queries on ${cluster} averaged {value} ms in the last 60 min over at least 300 queries: more than 200 ms while no baseline exists, else more than twice and 50 ms above the average of the same window 1 day or 1 week earlier.

checks.name: Couchbase ${cluster} N1QL queue
checks.title: {value} N1QL queries queued in ${cluster}
checks.text: Up to {value} N1QL queries waited in the query service queue on ${cluster} in the last 60 min: the query service is short of workers.

checks.name: Couchbase ${cluster} REST auth failures
checks.title: {value} REST auth failures in ${cluster}
checks.text: {value} Couchbase REST requests failed authentication on ${cluster} in the last 60 min: a client with a wrong or rotated password, or someone probing the admin port.

checks.name: Couchbase ${cluster} no series
checks.title: no Couchbase series for ${cluster}
checks.text: The selector of the Couchbase preset for ${cluster} matches no up series in Prometheus, so every other check of this preset is quiet: check the selector and that Prometheus scrapes the Couchbase exporter.
